notes: Step-level cases: one workflow question + one caller reply (see run_hub_cases.py).
*-R* = real replies from the DEMO calls of 2026-11-25 (source_calls); *-U* = the user's permission rule; *-N* = replies not seen in those calls, one per kind of answer in the category.
Utterances are written the way Sarvam STT returns them. No real name, number or address.
OK-* = every question/reply pair of the calls that went right on 2026-11-25 (report rows 36, 61, 70): these must keep their destination.
STATE-* = 'theek hai / ok / sahi' at a question about a state: it may describe the state, so it is never taken as a plain yes there.
REG-* = steps of haier_test_cases.json that an early version of the answer options broke (BILL-05, CB-04, ID-03, RTP-06, SVC-01).
2026-11-26: a stop-calling request must end on the flow's own repeated-calls closing; the platform do-not-call line is never an accepted result for this bot.
